verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS meeting assistant like Fathom, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls, or any opt-out mechanism. The bot-free capture option is a different feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
